shortDescription: Manages accounts on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account_type
options.description: Type of the account.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the account is related to.

options.name: email
options.description: Email of the user to be created if account did not exist. Required on I(state=present) if I(ldap_domain) is not set.

options.name: first_name
options.description: First name of the user to be created if account did not exist. Required on I(state=present) if I(ldap_domain) is not set.

options.name: last_name
options.description: Last name of the user to be created if account did not exist. Required on I(state=present) if I(ldap_domain) is not set.

options.name: ldap_domain
options.description: Name of the LDAP group or OU to bind. If set, account will be linked to LDAP.

options.name: ldap_type
options.description: Type of the ldap name. GROUP or OU, defaults to GROUP.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of account.

options.name: network_domain
options.description: Network domain of the account.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user to be created if account did not exist. Required on I(state=present) if I(ldap_domain) is not set.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: role
options.description: Creates the account under the specified role name or id.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the account. C(unlocked) is an alias for C(enabled).

options.name: timezone
options.description: Timezone of the user to be created if account did not exist.

options.name: username
options.description: Username of the user to be created if account did not exist. Required on I(state=present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
